''The Journey'' is the largest project for [[La Bangu]]. It consists of:
== 1. The [[The Crash Course in Lojban]] ==
*It's a continuation of [[la gleki|La Gleki]]'s [https://docs.google.com/document/d/101dgwoA60kGbn7ii9HzXJBfZu-RDUzKGcQ9bMkEkCjc/edit?usp=drive_web introduction to Lojban] but it also uses appropriate parts of [[L4B]], [[Lojban Wave Lessons|Wave lessons]] and [[CLL]] as well as different insights from [[Lojban IRC|IRC ]]residents and textbooks on other languages.
*It tries not to use Lojbanic terminology much. It explains most Lojbanic terms in ordinary language (e.g. '''[[tanru]]''' are ''compound verbs'' etc.)
*It is to be written in native languages of learners. The first edition is to be written in English.
*Examples of its parts: "Lojban as a simple language for everyday use", "Lojban compared to specific features in other languages", "Lojban for logicians", "Math in Lojban"
*It has a small dictionary as an addendum that gives examples to every basic brivla and cmavo. Some lass used cmavo and gismu are not included.
=== 1.2. [[Not ready: "Speak Lojban!" course|"Speak Lojban!" course]] ===
Primarily a phrasebook.

== 2. Lojban in slides ==
Somewhat an superfluous to 1. However, most people usually prefer to change from one textbook to another. That's why we provide this alternative.

[https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=682625275122026&set=a.659055840812303.1073741825.100001236786253&type=1 Lojban in slides].
== 3. Interactive stuff ==
*Audio recordings
*Audio applications ala Flash apps (but on HTML5) showing the pronounciation of Lojban sounds
*Video introductions
== 4. [[La Bangu: dictionary]] ==
== 5. [[La Bangu: stories in La Bangu]] ==
Different texts for beginners
== 6. [[:Category:ELG|ELG]] ==
The full reference grammar. It is an optional part, it is not to be included into all published editions. And the goal is that it is to be written in Lojban.
== 7. [[Test of Lojban as a Second Language]] ==
An exam that is to be developed
